searchPhrase.title: Search phrase
searchPhrase.description: Optional literal name substring, at most 100 characters. Omit for browsing.

category.title: Category
category.description: Optional exact experience category. Omit if not specified.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Optional first session date in Central Time. Omit for today. Must be within the next 365 days.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Optional last session date inclusive, no more than 30 days after startDate. Omit for the default.

guestCount.title: Guest count
guestCount.description: Optional number of guests, from 1 to 100. Omit for 1.
